title: Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.01882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. translated_title: 更快地流动以实现协调：一步式在线多智能体流策略
translated_abstract: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）提供了一个强大的框架，能够通过与环境的交互来学习协调行为。开发MARL策略需要在复杂多模态动作分布的富表现力建模与高效的训练及执行之间取得平衡。生成式策略，尤其是基于扩散的策略，能够忠实地捕捉复杂且多模态的行为，但其代价高昂的迭代采样阻碍了它们在在线多智能体场景中的可扩展性。我们提出了一种基于一步流模型的在线MARL框架（OMAF），将富有表现力的生成式策略与高效的一步动作生成相结合。OMAF采用基于Transformer的流策略来捕捉复杂的协调行为，同时其近似路径得分代理为同步流策略优化提供了一条有原则的途径。为实现稳定且样本高效的学习，我们进一步开发了联合优化方案……
tldr: 提出OMAF框架，利用基于Transformer的一步式流策略生成动作，在保留生成式策略捕捉复杂多模态协调行为能力的同时，将采样降至单步，实现高效稳定的在线多智能体强化学习。
en_tdlr: OMAF is an online multi-agent RL framework that employs a Transformer-based one-step flow policy with an approximate path score surrogate, combining expressive modeling of complex multimodal coordination behaviors with efficient one-step action generation for scalable online training.
